display.summary: Inspector-backed builders, configurable ribbon actions, reusable list pages, modal managers, and section/form cleanup for system surfaces.
highlights: Nav Bar, Sidebar, and Ribbon builders share the Dlux inspector shell with anchored popover editing and icon-picker integration.
Ribbon configuration discovers declared page actions, filters destinations, de-duplicates endpoints, and supports custom/removable/restorable buttons.
Dynamic modal managers provide list/form/detail flows with guarded deletes, modal-owned navigation, and footerless table lists.
Section Management uses an expandable editor, stable form grids/footer toggles, one dismiss control, and a shortcut-only sidebar toggle.
File upload helpers and markup move from archive_file naming to file_field naming with v1.x compatibility shims.
